result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names instead of fixed literals, so renaming a scope aspect no longer breaks the export. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or try a renamed config, so the fix is untested.

The change is in `reports/.../dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, in the zip step of the data export. It builds the five entries (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) in that order. Each name comes from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, which is also what writes the loose `aspect_<name>.txt` files, so the zip looks up exactly the files that were written.

With the default config the entries are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` as the aspect name, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written again too, because it was only being skipped when the `all_files.zip` step threw.
